name: Codex Settings
headline: Codex Settings - OpenAI Codex CLI Configurations
short_description: OpenAI Codex CLI settings, configurations, and prompts for vibe coding. Enhances development workflows with reusable templates. Connects to model providers and integrates with Claude Code.
author: feiskyer

sections.overview:
Codex-settings provides a comprehensive collection of configurations and custom prompts designed to optimize OpenAI Codex CLI for development workflows. It supports multiple model providers including LiteLLM, ChatGPT, Azure OpenAI, and OpenRouter, allowing developers to choose their preferred AI backend. The repository includes pre-built custom prompts for common tasks like GitHub issue fixing, pull request review, UI engineering, and prompt creation. Skills—experimental instruction bundles—enable automated task execution, including Claude Code integration and long-running task automation. Easy installation via git clone or npx makes it accessible for developers seeking streamlined AI-assisted coding experiences.
Configure Codex CLI to work with GitHub Copilot, Azure OpenAI, or ChatGPT subscriptions
Use pre-built prompts for GitHub issue analysis, PR review, and UI component creation
Automate development tasks with Claude Code through hands-off skill execution
Run long-running complex tasks across multiple sessions with autonomous automation
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/feiskyer/codex-settings`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
